gyms.name: Frostpine Gym
gyms.leader_intro: "My Pokémon and I grew up in this cold. Show me you can stand it."
gyms.leader_defeat: "The cold showed you mercy. Take the Frostpike Badge."

gyms.name: Hollyhollow Gym
gyms.leader_intro: "The festival lights flicker for a reason. Let's see if you can keep your footing in the dark."
gyms.leader_defeat: "The lanterns burn brighter for you now. The Hollowwick Badge is yours."

gyms.name: Krampus Keep Gym
gyms.leader_intro: "So you have chosen the hard path. Ring the bell if you dare."
gyms.leader_defeat: "You think you've stopped us? You've only rung the first bell."

frostpike_badge.name: Frostpike Badge
frostpike_badge.description: Awarded for defeating Captain Isolde of the Frostpine Gym.

hollowwick_badge.name: Hollowwick Badge
hollowwick_badge.description: Awarded for defeating Lantern Keeper Bram of the Hollyhollow Gym.

bellringer_badge.name: Bellringer Badge
bellringer_badge.description: Awarded for defeating Director Krampus of the Krampus Keep Gym.
